newsitem.title: USA: Lake Ariel Bancorp raises payout 6 pct.
newsitem.headline: Lake Ariel Bancorp raises payout 6 pct.

text.p: Lake Ariel Bancorp Inc on Tuesday declared a third-quarter dividend of $0.18 per share, or six percent more than the previous payment of $0.17.
The dividend is payable September 12 to holders of record on August 22.
The company said the increase would bring dividends for the first nine months of the year to a total of $0.52, up 8 percent from the $0.48 paid in the same period of 1996.
The Pennsylvania bank, which has 11 branch offices, said the increase was a direct result of record seven-month earnings of $1,885,000, up 6 percent from the year-ago period.
